records.subject: You're in -- let's get Quartz Systems set up
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

Thanks for setting up Quartz Systems on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no first project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two Wrenfield emails (email:56638932, email:1e7b9e98) plus no tickets — no signal of engagement. Starter, 8 days left; self-serve activation possible but unlikely absent any activity.

draft.subject: One small next step for Quartz Systems
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

Following up on my note last week — no pressure if things have been busy. Starting out, the simplest step is a first project: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything about how your team would use it.

Best,
Nadia
